# Vendored @smogon/calc

This is a locally-built vendored copy of `@smogon/calc` at commit `920c5b8a4d015a236b0fbaeb8bd8b1e5ca008043`.

## Why Vendored?

The Champions/Generation-0 support in this commit has not yet been published to the npm registry. The latest npm release (0.11.0, published 2026-03-11) predates this commit and does not include Champions data.

This project requires Champions format support, so we vendor a working build directly from the GitHub repository.

## Sync Status

This vendored copy should be re-synced or replaced if/when Champions support ships in an official `@smogon/calc` npm release.

See: https://github.com/smogon/damage-calc
